corpus.title: Refund policy
corpus.text: Members can request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method and take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

corpus.title: Cancel a membership plan
corpus.text: Go to Account Settings, then Billing, then click Cancel Plan. Access continues until the end of the paid period. Cancelled plans cannot be reactivated; sign up again.

corpus.title: Change your site theme colour
corpus.text: Open Design Settings, choose Theme, and pick a colour from the palette. Click Save. Changes appear on the live site within one minute.

corpus.title: Connect Stripe payments
corpus.text: Open Settings, then Payments, and click Connect Stripe. Log in to Stripe and authorise. Supported currencies are USD, EUR and GBP.

corpus.title: Edit SEO title and description
corpus.text: Each page has an SEO tab. Enter a title up to 60 characters and a description up to 160 characters. Leave blank to use defaults.

corpus.title: Import members from CSV
corpus.text: Go to Members, then Import. Upload a CSV with columns email, first_name, last_name. Maximum 5,000 rows per file. Duplicates by email are skipped.

corpus.title: Connect a custom domain
corpus.text: Add a CNAME record pointing www to sites.example.com at your registrar. DNS can take up to 48 hours. SSL is issued automatically after verification.

corpus.title: Goodwill credits
corpus.text: If a billing error was our fault, support can issue a goodwill credit of one month on the plan. Contact support within 30 days of the error.

corpus.title: Customise email templates
corpus.text: Open Settings, then Emails, select a template, and edit the subject and body. Use {first_name} as a placeholder. Send a test email before saving.

corpus.title: Staff roles and permissions
corpus.text: Admins can manage everything. Editors can change content but not billing. Viewers have read-only access. Assign roles under Settings, Team.
